clips.title: The story
paras: In Orgrimmar, Varok Saurfang commands the Horde's war forces under Warchief Thrall. The veteran of the Old Horde's wars lends the young Horde his strength and experience.

Varok Saurfang carries the Old Horde's wars into the present. Few living warriors match his record, and many regard him as unstoppable in battle. Now High Overlord in Orgrimmar, he helps hold together Thrall's newborn Horde.
Varok Saurfang defends the Horde and enforces Thrall's rule against threats. He does not seek battle for its own sake. He despises warmongering and fights for honor and the Horde's preservation.
